name: Date Kaname
source:
Name: Kaname Date
Sex: Male
Age: 30
[spoiler]True Age: 42 ([i]AI[/I]-[I]AINS[/I]-[i]AINI[/i] Past) | 48 ([i]AINI[/i] Present)[/spoiler]
Birthday: August 3
Profession: ABIS Officer
Likes: Classic Cars, Curry, Bonito, Pelvises, Reika, Family
Dislikes: Soft-boiled eggs, Punk Kids, Ghosts
Hobbies: Collects "vintage magazines"
Skills: Reaction time increases 3.6 times under certain conditions

In [i][url=/v26532]AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES[/url][/i]:
As a Psyncer, Date uses the Psync machine to dive into the minds of suspects of persons of interest. He lost his eye six years ago, but replaced it with a prosthetic eye which houses an advanced artificial intelligence known as an AI-Ball. He also lost all his memories past six years ago.

In [i][url=/v55357]No Sleep For Kaname Date – From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES[/url][/I]:
An ABIS investigator [spoiler]and Mizuki's foster father[/spoiler]. He's also close to Iris and Ota. One of his biggest concerns recently is how to deal with excessive sweating on his face and neck.

In [i][url=/v31469]AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative[/url][/i]:
[Past]
An ABIS Special Agent on a long break. He takes good care of Ryuki, both at and outside of work. [spoiler]He is Mizuki's adoptive father and gets along with Iris and Ota.[/spoiler] Currently feuding with Aiba.
[Present]
[spoiler]He wandered all over the country after losing his memory in the explosion 6 years ago. After seeing the news of Jin's left half being found, he regained all his memories. In order to perform his own investigation, he used Gen's mask...[/spoiler]

[From the in-game character descriptions]

[spoiler]Date's conciousness inhabits Saito's body during the events of the first game. Once he returns to his original body, he wears a fake Saito mask during the events of the other games.[/spoiler]
